description: Hook points fired by aos-mcp: aos tools called through it (the CLI's own tools do not pass here).

before_tool.when: before an aos tool called through aos-mcp runs

fields.name: tool name
fields.id: the JSON-RPC id as a string (empty when none)
fields.arguments: the arguments the tool will get

before_tool.subject: tool
before_tool.if_blocked: the tool does not run; the CLI gets the hook's stdout (or a default line) as the result

after_tool.when: an aos tool called through aos-mcp finished (not for a blocked tool)

fields.name: tool name
fields.id: the JSON-RPC id as a string (empty when none)
fields.content: all text parts joined into one
fields.code: the tool's exit code, null when it timed out

after_tool.subject: tool
